lines.en: I shoot low across the bed.
My body stretches into a line.
I cut a seam across the surface.
I circle these waters.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下，就到了对岸
lines.en: One flick and I am across.

lines.zh: 我滑过的时候水都让开
lines.en: Water parts as I pass.
I edge toward the shore.
I glide along the rock face.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在水里几乎不动
lines.en: My fins barely move in the water.
I slide and listen as I go.
I hover in the water, waiting.
My armour throws back the water's light.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是看着
lines.en: I do nothing; I only watch.

lines.zh: 这片水域的鱼都归我管。
lines.en: Every fish in this water answers to me.
I have no reason to hurry.
My body sways gently.
The water is unnaturally quiet.
I am measuring how far you are from shore.
My gills open and close slowly.
I do not need to surface.
The bed bears the marks I leave.
I watch the broken light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把我送过去
lines.en: I wait for the tide to move me.
No other seaborn here.
Spines line my shell.
I turn half around and stop.
You have stood there a long while.
I lift, and the surface breaks.
I am looking at you, not the shore.
You carry a living warmth.
Do not put your hand in the water.

lines.zh: 我知道你带了几件武器
lines.en: I know how many weapons you carry.
Retreat, and I still follow.
I know what a hunter looks like.
The bottom by your feet is deep.
I raise my body slowly.
You do not need to say anything.
In this stretch, I decide.
A dent is knocked into my armour.
I pull back into deeper water.
I have carved that into my armour.
My gills clench.
The water shed most of the force.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我转头正对着你。
lines.en: After the hit, I turn to face you squarely.
One of my spines has snapped.
I make a low sound.
I will come again before long.
This wound will not stop me.
That does not interest me.
Holding it high does nothing.

lines.zh: 我吃的东西会自己过来
lines.en: What I eat comes to me.
The real bait here is you.
I am not hungry at all.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是那样东西
lines.en: I watch your hand, not the thing.
Lower it, let me look.
I am not short of food.

lines.zh: 这一带的东西都被我吃光了
lines.en: I have eaten this area clean.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的鳍就收一分。
lines.en: For every step you retreat, my fins pull back a little.
You hit my armour.
I barely gave an inch.
You are thrown right back.
My spines rake you.
Wading is too slow.
A ring of waves shoves outward.
That trade was bad for you.

lines.zh: 我只是侧了侧身，你就撞空了。
lines.en: I merely turn my flank, and your charge hits nothing.
My tail sweeps past your feet.
Do not walk along the waterline.
I am alone in these waters.
Seaborn do not breed so.
All I do is spread.
There is no need to speak of it.
I keep this stretch.
Your question has no answer.
I am growing, not courting.
I sink away into the deep.

lines.zh: 我甩尾转身，游回深水里。
lines.en: I flick my tail, turn, and swim back into the deep.
There is only one shadow on the bed.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西都属于我
lines.en: Whatever sinks belongs to me.
I swallow without asking.
It still tries to move in my mouth.
Not enough to fill a tooth.
I drag it down.
I hold it until it stops.
I sink with it.
I smell whose it was.
I leave nothing behind me.
This is not worth moving for.
I have found you at last.
You are within forty-eight paces of me.
My armour has risen.

lines.zh: 这一片水里没有你的位置
lines.en: There is no place for you in this water.
Your warmth cannot hide.
If I move first, you will be too late.

lines.zh: 我在水底看着你很久了
lines.en: I have watched you from the bed a long while.
The moment you stepped into the water.
My mark is on you now.
Everything in this water is mine.
I do not intend to let you reach the shore.
I lower my body slowly.

lines.zh: 你听见水下的动静了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that under the water?
You will serve nicely.

lines.zh: 所有鳍都张开，我准备扑了。
lines.en: Every fin spreads wide; I am ready to lunge.
Backing out now is too late.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我一下一下数
lines.en: I count your heartbeat, beat by beat.
I have already started moving.
I come along the bed.
I am right beneath your feet.
Back toward shore, and I follow.
Each pass brings me closer.
I make not a single sound.
My armour glints below the surface.
Your shadow lies on the water.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩进浅的地方
lines.en: I wait for you to step where it is shallow.

lines.zh: 我的影子又朝你挪近一尺。
lines.en: My shadow slides another foot closer to you.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我立刻换了个角度。
lines.en: The instant you turn, I shift my angle.
The water is only so deep. Where will you hide?
My gills are working.
I flatten like an arrow.
Back up again and you will be against stone.

lines.zh: 我潜在水面下，等你低头看。
lines.en: I lie just under the surface, waiting for you to look down.
I know every inch of this water.
I will not announce myself.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，就够得着你了。
lines.en: One more step and you are within my reach.
My whole body has drawn tight.
I strike at last.
I burst through the water beside you.
My spines bite into your armour.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我把全身的重量压上。
lines.en: I put my whole weight behind this charge.
The impact tumbles you into the water.
My tail lashes you.
The water is my ground.
You retreat, but the water follows.
And I lunge again.

lines.zh: 血丝在水里散成一团红雾。
lines.en: Threads of blood bloom into a red haze in the water.
Head-on, you lose.
I pin you into the shallows.
That blow left room.
Do not think the bank is safe.
I slip away and come back.
The surface splits and I rise.
The colour of the whole water changes.
I came up from deep water.
These waters have no master yet.
My armour breaks the surface first.

lines.zh: 我一起身，水底的泥全翻了。
lines.en: The moment I rise, the bottom mud churns up.
The fish scatter when I arrive.
I rise up slowly.
The water here is good.
I flatten a patch of weeds.
I open my gills and taste the water.
Everything on the bank is watching.

lines.zh: 我从泥里浮起，不急着动手。
lines.en: I rise from the mud in no hurry to strike.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，认下这片水
lines.en: I circle once and claim this water.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住整片浅滩
lines.en: My shadow covers the shallows.
This place will keep me a long while.
I settle back into the water.
I am here, and the water goes quiet.
The tide nudges me toward the bank.
I lift my head and look at the sky.
The water heats, and my armour scalds.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛到石头上
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto stone.
Even I can be crushed by too much water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀起来
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the water.
An arrow cracks against my shell.

lines.zh: 魔法穿水打在我的鳃上
lines.en: Magic pierces the water into my gills.
Nothing living is left in this water.
Lightning finds me along the surface.
The water and the ground are gone.
